primarySources.fact: The native template directly invokes Footnotes.sfn.
The module reads parent numeric args1..5 and emits a generated FOOTNOTE-prefixed name. The anonymous outer extension tag is not an argument frame.

derivation: Removing only the complete anonymous outer ref leaves the native template invocation and its argument frame byte-exact, including duplicate numeric bindings and their existing resolution. No duplicate is removed, reordered, chosen or assigned a new value. The independently proved nested-note repair changes the outer Cite structure and is deliberately nonminor.
exception: Only the existing exact native Sfn identity and repeated canonical numeric1..5. Existing literal/source/bank/generated-dependency guards and exact helper-event equality remain active.
refusals: Noncanonical numeric0/01/6+ or unknown fields in a duplicate-numeric candidate
Duplicate or competing nonnumeric role aliases
Dynamic values, unknown parents, quoted/code examples and list-defined banks
Raw FOOTNOTE dependencies or a mutated helper payload
